Message:
tcp: tcp_syn_flood_action() can be static

After commit 1fb6f159fd21 ("tcp: add tcp_conn_request"),
tcp_syn_flood_action() is no longer used from IPv6.

We can make it static, by moving it above tcp_conn_request()
